topic: What is NKOCET? history, affiliation, accreditation and location
answer: Nagesh Karajagi Orchid College of Engineering & Technology (NKOCET) is an autonomous engineering institute in Solapur, Maharashtra, managed by Pradnya Niketan Education Society, Pune. It was established in 2008. The official website states that it is approved by AICTE, recognized by the Government of Maharashtra, affiliated with Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University (DBATU), Lonere, and accredited NAAC A+. The overview page describes a 10.6-acre campus near Hipparga Lake.

topic: Vision, mission and core values
answer: NKOCET’s vision is to be a leading technological institute recognized for academic excellence, industry readiness, and developing globally competent technocrats. Its mission includes teaching and learning excellence, creativity and critical thinking, industry collaboration, holistic education, employable skills, innovation, research, and consultancy. Its stated values include quality education, innovation, excellence, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and social responsibility.

topic: Principal and principal’s message
answer: The official website identifies Dr. B. K. Sonage as Principal. The Principal’s office lists 9423084363 and office@orchidengg.ac.in.

topic: Engineering branches, programs and current intake
answer: For admissions 2026–27, NKOCET lists these B.Tech branches and intakes: Civil Engineering (60), Computer Science & Engineering (180), Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering (60), Mechanical Engineering (120), Electrical Engineering (60), and Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (60). It also lists M.Tech programs in Computer Aided Structural Analysis & Design (12), Thermal Engineering (6), and Electric Vehicle Technology (6). Intake is subject to the official current admission disclosure.

topic: Admission process and where to apply
answer: NKOCET’s admissions page covers academic year 2026–27 and links the admission brochure, schedules, vacancy positions, and merit lists. Applicants should follow the Maharashtra CET Cell/DTE schedule. The college’s guidance says the process is handled through the institute ERP, fee payment is online after admission, and applicants report to the Admission Seminar Hall in A Building. First-year engineering contact: Prof. S. D. Jadhav, 9552529255, admission@orchidengg.ac.in. The office number is +91 217 299 0051.

topic: B.Tech and M.Tech eligibility criteria
answer: For B.Tech 2026–27, the admissions page lists HSC/equivalent with Physics and Mathematics plus an approved third subject and at least 45% marks (40% for specified Maharashtra reserved-category and PwD candidates); Maharashtra applicants must also appear in CET and obtain a non-zero score. It also lists diploma and D.Voc. pathways under the applicable rules. M.Tech eligibility includes a relevant bachelor’s degree with 50% marks (45% for specified Maharashtra categories) and a valid GATE score, with stated exceptions. Verify your exact category and route in the current CET Cell brochure.

topic: Tuition, fee structure and scholarships for 2026–27
answer: NKOCET’s 2026–27 admissions page lists total fees of ₹1,18,500 for first-year B.Tech (₹1,03,044 tuition + ₹15,456 development), ₹1,15,000 for direct second-year B.Tech (₹1,00,000 + ₹15,000), and ₹70,000 for M.Tech (₹60,870 + ₹9,130). Fee status and applicable concessions can depend on category and approval; confirm the latest official notice before payment. The admission guidance page links scholarship information.

topic: Placement support, activities and recruiters
answer: NKOCET’s Training & Placement Cell provides soft-skills and aptitude sessions from second year onward, mock technical and HR interviews, mock group discussions, company-specific preparation before drives, internships, industry interaction, expert talks, and career guidance. The official page lists Dr. R. R. Patil as Dean, Training & Placement (tpo@orchidengg.ac.in; +91 97671 07293) and describes seminar halls, group-discussion cabins, and interview rooms. Recruiter names and placement statistics vary by year; check the latest T&P report. The college does not guarantee a placement or salary.

topic: Campus facilities, infrastructure, hostel, canteen, sports and gym
answer: The college overview lists laboratories, smart classrooms, a library, hostel accommodation, canteen, sports facilities, and a gymnasium. The hostel page describes separate boys’ and girls’ hostels, Wi-Fi, dining, security, recreation, and medical support. Check the linked official pages for current availability and terms.

topic: Hostel facilities, accommodation, wardens and rectors
answer: NKOCET’s official page describes separate boys’ and girls’ hostels, 60 boys’ rooms and 41 girls’ rooms with attached bathrooms, vegetarian mess dining, Wi-Fi, CCTV and security, recreation areas, housekeeping, first aid, on-call medical support, and hospital tie-ups. Allotment is first-come-first-served, with preference for outstation students. The page lists boys’ rector Prof. Roshan Pushpan at 8380048424 / rector_boyshostel@orchidengg.ac.in and girls’ rector Dr. Ashwini Vidyasagar Sadlapurkar at 9552529263 / rector_girlshostel@orchidengg.ac.in. Published hostel office hours are Monday–Saturday, 9 AM–5 PM. Confirm current vacancies, fees, mess charges, and rules with the respective rector; do not guess.

topic: Central Library location, hours, resources and services
answer: NKOCET’s Central Library was established in 2008. The official library page lists 60,917+ books, 76 national and international journals, e-books, e-resources, Ekeeda and NPTEL access, OPAC, iSLIM software, barcode circulation, a Book Bank, reading and reference sections, competitive-exam resources, reprography, and research assistance. It is on the first floor of Building A. Published library hours are Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM–5:15 PM; Sunday and national holidays are closed. The reading room is listed as open 9:00 AM–11:00 PM. Confirm current access arrangements with the library.

topic: Bus routes, transportation facilities and office hours
answer: NKOCET operates buses for parts of Solapur and nearby areas, with routes planned for major residential areas and surrounding towns. The official page says buses have GPS tracking, CCTV, first-aid kits, trained drivers, and regular maintenance. It does not publish route numbers, pickup points, or fees. Published transport office hours are Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; the page does not give a usable phone number or room number. Contact the college transport office for current route and fare details.

topic: Research, innovation and entrepreneurship
answer: NKOCET’s official site lists a Research & Development Cell, research projects, publications, collaborations and MoUs, an Institute Innovation Cell (IIC), and an Entrepreneurship Cell. The IIC was established in 2018 and supports ideation, prototype development, workshops, hackathons, innovation challenges, industry and incubation links, mentorship, and startup development. Check the official pages for current projects, events, and opportunities.

topic: Study abroad and international preparation
answer: The college overview says the Study Abroad Cell provides specialized coaching for GATE, GRE, TOEFL, and IELTS and supports students pursuing higher education opportunities globally. Check the Study Abroad Cell for current programs and schedules.

topic: Scholarship schemes and eligibility
answer: NKOCET’s 2026 scholarship information lists Maharashtra government schemes including post-matric support for eligible reserved-category students, EBC fee scholarships, minority scholarships, and hostel maintenance schemes, along with AICTE Pragati (women), Saksham (students with disabilities), and Swanath schemes. Eligibility, CAP admission conditions, income limits, and benefits vary by scheme. The college’s scholarship guide links to the relevant portals; confirm current requirements with the college office before applying.

topic: Competitions, cultural activities and student clubs
answer: The official website highlights technical competitions including Aavishkar and Smart India Hackathon, the annual technical event Orchitech, student exchange opportunities, and cultural festival activities. The site does not provide a single complete directory of current student clubs; contact the college or relevant department for active club details and schedules.

topic: College address, phone and email
answer: NKOCET is at Gat No. 16, Solapur–Tuljapur Road, near Mashroom Ganapati Temple, Tale-Hipparaga, Solapur 413002. The official contact page lists 0217 299 0051 / 094230 84363 and office@orchidengg.ac.in, contactus@orchidengg.ac.in, and admission@orchidengg.ac.in.

topic: Exam cell, timetables, results and exam calendar
answer: NKOCET’s Examination Cell publishes exam calendars, current timetables, circulars, results, exam forms, rules, and previous question papers. Calendars include internal assessments, practicals, mid-semester, end-semester, and make-up examinations; dates can change, so check the latest circulars and timetable on the Examination Cell page.

topic: Canteen food and hours
answer: NKOCET’s canteen is near the hostel and offers meals, snacks, beverages, vegetarian and vegan choices, and seating. The official page publishes hours of 8:30 AM–6:00 PM, Monday–Saturday. The live menu, prices, and current service details can change, so check with the canteen.

topic: Sports, gymnasium and student activities
answer: NKOCET lists a cricket pitch with practice nets, football field, volleyball and basketball courts, running track and athletics area, and kabaddi and kho-kho grounds. The gymnasium page lists treadmills, exercise bikes, cross-trainers, dumbbells, barbells, bench press, Smith machine, kettlebells, and resistance bands, plus scheduled yoga and aerobics. The page names Prof. S. M. Gaikwad as Physical Director and describes inter-college tournaments, sports meets, coaching, and evening/weekend activities. Confirm current timings and availability with the Sports Office.

topic: Latest notices and changing information
answer: Notices and dates change frequently. The college homepage and Examination Cell link to current admissions, examination, tender, and academic announcements. Check the official Notices page directly for the latest updates; the Examination Cell page is the official source for exam circulars and timetables.

topic: Computer Science and Engineering department, facilities and intake
answer: The Computer Science & Engineering department was established in 2008. For 2026–27, NKOCET lists a B.Tech intake of 180. Its official page describes 10 modern computer laboratories with Dell, HP, and Lenovo systems, networking, multimedia, databases, AI, and advanced programming facilities, along with Linux and Windows systems, UPS backup, and high-speed internet. The department supports workshops, expert talks, industry visits, internships, student projects, and the CSE Students’ Association.

topic: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science department, labs, software and location
answer: NKOCET’s AI & Data Science B.Tech programme began in academic year 2021–22 and has a published intake of 60. The department describes interdisciplinary study in computer science, mathematics, AI, machine learning, statistics, and data science. Its official page lists Python, R, TensorFlow, PyTorch, MATLAB, SQL, and cloud-computing platforms, plus AI and data-science laboratories, UPS backup, high-speed internet, expert workshops, projects, and student activities. The department’s published location is the second floor of C Building. Check the admissions page for the current year’s intake.

topic: Civil Engineering department, location, facilities and intake
answer: For 2026–27, NKOCET lists a B.Tech Civil Engineering intake of 60. The department was established in 2008 and is in E Building (Civil Wing). Its official page lists 6 classrooms, 11 laboratories, and 24 faculty members, with a 1:15 faculty–student ratio. Published subject and laboratory areas include surveying, strength of materials, concrete technology, fluid mechanics, engineering geology, applied mechanics, structural engineering, and sustainable infrastructure. Confirm current faculty or service details on the department page.

topic: Mechanical Engineering department, laboratories and intake
answer: For 2026–27, NKOCET lists a B.Tech Mechanical Engineering intake of 120. The department page describes practical and project-based learning in thermal engineering, design, production, CAD/CAM, manufacturing, fluid mechanics, machine design, mechatronics, and automobile engineering. Its current published facilities list includes 19 laboratories, including CAD/CAM, applied thermodynamics, manufacturing processes, theory of machines, workshop, fluid power and machinery, metallurgy, metrology, heat transfer, IC engines, mechatronics, solar research, and engineering graphics. Check the official page for the latest lab and course details.

topic: Electrical Engineering department, laboratories and intake
answer: For 2026–27, NKOCET lists a B.Tech Electrical Engineering intake of 60. The department page lists 11 laboratories and practical work in power systems, electrical machines, control systems, electronics, power electronics and drives, measurements, PLC/SCADA, and renewable-energy projects. It also describes industrial visits, expert talks, workshops, research, and innovation activities. Confirm current course and laboratory details on the official department page.

topic: Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering department, facilities and intake
answer: For 2026–27, NKOCET lists a B.Tech Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering intake of 60. The department page describes hands-on learning in electronics, communication systems, embedded systems, VLSI, signal processing, IoT, and connected systems. It lists advanced laboratories, a student-accessible electronics components library for projects, industry visits, expert talks, workshops, research, and project-based learning. Check the official page for current department activities.

topic: Verified college building and floor locations; asking for directions
answer: The official NKOCET pages publish these internal locations: Central Library — first floor, Building A; AI & Data Science department — second floor, C Building; Civil Engineering — E Building (Civil Wing). The sources reviewed do not establish room numbers or exact routes for other departments and offices. For an unlisted location or step-by-step campus directions, ask the main office or reception rather than guessing.

topic: Official college committees and reporting student concerns
answer: NKOCET’s official committees page lists the Anti-Ragging Committee and Squad, Internal Complaints Committee, SC/ST Committee, Equal Opportunity Facilitation Cell, Institution Industry Cell, Internal Quality Assurance Cell, Media Cell, College Development Committee, R&D and IIC Committee, and Grievance Redressal Committee. If a student reports ragging, harassment, or discrimination, respond sensitively and direct them to the appropriate committee or college office. Do not promise an outcome or disclose another person’s complaint details.

topic: General Engineering and First-Year Engineering department
answer: NKOCET’s official General Engineering page describes a separate First-Year Engineering department that provides foundation teaching across engineering disciplines. It lists physics and materials science, chemistry and environmental science, employability skills, civil and mechanical engineering, programming, manufacturing, electrical and electronics engineering, engineering graphics/CAD, and engineering mechanics laboratories. The page lists Prof. S. D. Jadhav as Head of Department; confirm current details with the department.
